note: The agent level instruments of TDD section 7.5, frozen and hashed into queries/agent-manifest.json before the first agent run. Never edited to move a score.

instructions.F6:
You are looking at a software repository in the current folder. Answer this question about it:

{question}

Find the code that answers it. Use {tools} to look through the code. Do not change any files.

When you are done, end your reply with one JSON block, and nothing after it:
```json
{"files": ["path/relative/to/the/repository", "..."], "locations": ["path:line", "..."], "answer": "the answer in two or three sentences"}
```
Cite the code that answers it in locations, the best first.

tools.rg: the Grep, Glob and Read tools
tools.index: the unluminous_search tool (its find, def, refs, fragment, outline and files commands) and the Read tool

success.F5: Success when at least half of the ticket's gold files are among the first five files the agent names. Paths are compared relative to the repository, case insensitive, with forward slashes.
success.F6: Success when one of the first three locations the agent cites is in the gold file, at a line inside the gold span or within 5 lines of it, AND the grader says the answer is correct.

subset.note: The inner loop runs a fixed subset of the dev split; the gate runs the whole held out split with 3 draws per task per arm.
